header.what: Golden set for voice reminders (midas-intel docs/plans/2026-10-13-voice-reminders-v1.md, section 7). Each case: the sentence (say), a fixed context (now, time zone, lists), the ideal model reply (reply: only the fields that differ from the defaults below; title defaults to the expected title) and the exact expected result (expect).
header.expect: Either {title, date, time, repeat, list, notes} (time null = all-day, date null = no date; missing fields are null) or {status: 'not-done', reason}.
header.replyDefaults: isReminder true, notes null, whenKind derived, minutesFromNow null, daysFromNow null, date null, yearMissing false, weekday null, weekdayNext false, time null, ampmStated false, partOfDay null, repeat null, listId null, whenText '', confident true. A repeat's interval defaults to 1 and weekdays to [].
header.sources: Every sentence was written by hand for Midas, in the style of the create-reminder intents of TOPv2 and MASSIVE; no sentence is copied from either. Licences checked 2026-10-15: MASSIVE (Amazon, huggingface.co/datasets/AmazonScience/massive) is CC BY 4.0 per its dataset card; TOPv2 (Facebook, Chen et al. 2020, arXiv 2010.03546) is listed as CC BY-SA 4.0 on Papers with Code (not confirmed from the primary distribution page). Copying sentences from TOPv2 would bring its share-alike terms; none were copied.
header.rulesThatAreChoices: Where English is ambiguous the expected result follows the rules in backend/src/voice.ts: 'next <weekday>' is the first one after today (said on a Saturday, 'next Sunday' is tomorrow); a bare weekday said on that day is today if the time is ahead, and all-day counts as ahead; a time equal to now is not ahead.
